notes: All 12 views inspected. Long-necked brass ewer with a squat bulbous base, a tall tapering neck, a pinched pouring lip and a thin strap handle from lip to shoulder. Engraved floral bands run around the neck, shoulder and base and the top view confirms the open throat and spout. Title corrected: this is a handled ewer, not a bulbous vase.
limitations: The handle is slender geometry and may alias at distance.
Engraving is ornament only, with no lettering or maker's mark.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
